the resummation gain is pin-invariant, so higher orders do not own the residual

description: Every alpha_EM closed form the corpus carries, evaluated at both registered pins and scored in ppb against CODATA 2022 read from the NIST table. This is the producer tbl:em-coupling-projection-table1-data names in its own prose and the source of six of that table's seven rows; it previously emitted no witness, leaving those rows with no machine-readable provenance while a different probe claimed the block and computed only the bare form (qou-i229). Records the resummed CS tower (the table's 137.0359351 at the proton pin, -467.6 ppb), the order-2 truncation it supersedes, and the RULED-OUT PSLQ-empirical form -- which has the smallest residual of any form here, the signature of a fit rather than evidence for one.
caveats: The smallest residual belongs to the RULED-OUT PSLQ-empirical form. That is the signature of a fit, not evidence for it; the form is recorded only so the comparison is legible.
kappa is still a `sorry`. Exact closure at the proton pin needs 1.9153143 against Witten's 1.722, an 11.2 % gap, and nothing here derives it.
The muon-pin rows use the converged live pin from q-pinning-50-digit.witness.json, not the retired CODATA-2018 vintage that several content blocks still publish (qou-i229).
q0AnchorReason: scores every alpha_EM closed form at BOTH registered pins (proton Q_50_DIGIT_STR and the live muon pin from the muon anchor witness) and reports the muon->proton pin change; both pins are read on purpose
